abstract: Deregulation of stem cells is associated with the generation and progression of malignant tumors. In addition, genes that are associated with early embryogenesis are frequently expressed in cancer. Cripto-1 (CR-1), a glycosylphosphatidylinositol-linked glycoprotein, is expressed during early embryogenesis and in various human carcinomas. We demonstrated that human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells are heterogeneous for CR-1 expression and consist of two distinct subpopulations: a CR-1(High) and a CR-1(Low) population. By segregating CR-1(High) and CR-1(Low) populations of NTERA2/D1 EC cells by fluorescence-activated cell sorting, we demonstrated that CR-1(High) cells were more tumorigenic than CR-1(Low) cells by an in vitro tumor sphere assay and by in vivo xenograft formation. The CR-1(High) population was enriched in mRNA expression for the pluripotent embryonic stem (ES) cell genes Oct4, Sox2, and Nanog. CR-1 expression in NTERA2/D1 cells was regulated by a Smad2/3-dependent autocrine loop, by the ES cell-related transcription factors Oct4/Nanog, and partially by the DNA methylation status of the promoter region. These results demonstrate that CR-1 expression is enriched in an undifferentiated, tumorigenic subpopulation and is regulated by key regulators of pluripotent stem cells.
abstract_ja: ヒト胎児性癌(EC)細胞は、Cripto-1(CR-1)の発現について不均一であり、CR-1High集団とCR-1Low集団という2つのサブ集団から構成されることを示した。NTERA2/D1 EC細胞をフローサイトメトリーによりCR-1High細胞とCR-1Low細胞に分取したところ、in vitroのtumor sphere法およびin vivoの異種移植による腫瘍形成において、CR-1High細胞がCR-1Low細胞より腫瘍形成能が高かった。CR-1High集団では、多能性ES細胞遺伝子であるOct4、Sox2、NanogのmRNA発現が豊富であった。NTERA2/D1細胞においてCR-1の発現は、Smad2/3依存性の自己分泌ループ、ES細胞関連転写因子Oct4/Nanog、およびプロモーター領域のDNAメチル化状態により部分的に制御されていた。これらの結果から、CR-1の発現は未分化で腫瘍形成能を持つサブ集団で濃縮され、多能性幹細胞の主要な制御因子によって制御されることが示された。
